units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 3. The employer’s representative may redistribute funds from state bodies’ civil servants’ remuneration funds allocated for the respective payments among the payments provided for by part 2 of this Article.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 4. The civil servants’ remuneration fund is formed in accordance with a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, taking account of this Article. The amount provided when forming that fund may not be less than the amount established by this Article.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 40. Procedure for forming the civil servants’ remuneration fund
units.text: 5. Other payments provided for civil servants by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts and by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow, which do not form part of monetary remuneration — including the basic and additional guarantees established by this Law and provided in monetary form — and the retention of average wages for a civil servant holding a position being reduced who is sent for additional professional education, are financed from the budget of the City of Moscow in addition to the duly approved remuneration fund for the state body’s civil servants and employees.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 40

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.label: Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1. To ensure civil servants’ legal and social protection, increase their motivation to perform official duties effectively, strengthen the stability of the professional civil service workforce, and compensate for restrictions established by federal laws, civil servants are guaranteed:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1) equal remuneration conditions and comparable indicators for assessing the efficiency of professional service results when holding corresponding civil service positions, unless otherwise established by federal law;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2) the right to receive monetary remuneration in full and on time;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3) civil service conditions that ensure the performance of official duties in accordance with the official duties regulations;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4) rest, ensured by normal service hours, days off and non-working public holidays, and annual paid basic and additional leave; 5) medical insurance for the civil servant and their family members in accordance with federal laws, including after the civil servant retires on a length-of-service pension;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 6) compulsory state social insurance in accordance with federal laws against illness or incapacity for work during civil service, or retention of monetary remuneration during temporary incapacity for work and during examinations at a medical organization providing specialized medical care, in accordance with federal law;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 7) payments under compulsory state insurance in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and in the amounts established by a law of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 8) reimbursement of expenses connected with official business trips. The procedure and conditions for sending a civil servant on official business trips are established by regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9) reimbursement of expenses connected with relocation of the civil servant and their family members to another locality when the civil servant is transferred, on the employer’s representative’s initiative, to another civil service position in the same or another state body. The procedure and conditions for reimbursement are established by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 10) protection of the civil servant and their family members against violence, threats and other unlawful acts connected with the performance of official duties, in the cases, in accordance with the procedure and on the conditions established by federal law;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 11) state pension provision under the procedure and conditions established by the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2. Where a civil servant is released from the civil service position held because of election or appointment to a state office, election to an elected office in a local self-government body, or election (delegation) to a paid elected office in a trade union body, including an elected body of a primary trade union organization established in a state body, that civil servant’s pension provision conditions are determined according to their choice.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 41. Basic state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3. Civil servants shall also be provided with other state guarantees established by federal laws.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 41

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.label: Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1. Civil servants are provided with the following additional state guarantees:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 1) further professional education with retention of the civil service position held and monetary remuneration for that period;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2) transport services provided in connection with the performance of official duties, depending on the categories and groups of civil service positions held;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3) compensation for the use of personal transport for service purposes and reimbursement of associated expenses, depending on the categories and groups of civil service positions held;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4) filling another civil service position upon reduction of civil service positions or abolition of a state body in accordance with Article 28 of this Law;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 5) a one-time subsidy for the purchase of residential premises, provided once during the entire period of civil service, in accordance with the procedure and conditions established by a regulatory legal act of the City of Moscow. Until the relevant regulatory legal act is adopted, civil servants are provided with residential premises depending on their civil service conditions, and are registered as needing improved housing conditions or compensated for housing purchase expenses; 6) a free or discounted sanatorium or health-resort voucher provided for annual paid leave, with corresponding reimbursement for travel to and from the place of rest, and discounted sanatorium or health-resort vouchers for family members, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 7) compensation for an unused sanatorium or health-resort voucher;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 8) medical care, including for family members, depending on the category and group of the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9) free dispensing of all medicines on doctors’ prescriptions during outpatient treatment, free manufacture and repair of dental prostheses (except prostheses made of precious metals), and other prosthetic and orthopaedic assistance, including for family members depending on the category and group of the civil service position held, or corresponding monetary compensation;
units.label: Point 9 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 10) a one-time monetary incentive upon reaching the age of 50 and every five years thereafter, in an amount not exceeding two months’ monetary remuneration for the civil service position held;
units.label: Point 10 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 11) a one-time monetary incentive upon reaching 20 years of civil service and every five years thereafter, in an amount not exceeding two months’ monetary remuneration for the civil service position held, provided the person has at least five years of civil service in state bodies and local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 11 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 12) payment, once during the entire period of civil service, of a monetary reward upon retirement from civil service, calculated by multiplying the monthly monetary remuneration for the last civil service position held before termination of civil service by the number of full years of civil service, but counting no more than ten years as of the date of termination of civil service.
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: For civil servants who previously received an analogous payment upon termination of federal military service, federal law-enforcement service, federal state civil service, state civil service of other constituent entities of the Russian Federation or municipal service in the Russian Federation, the payment is made in proportion to the number of full years of civil service in state bodies and local self-government bodies;
units.label: Point 12 Part 1 Art. 42 · “For civil servants who previously received an analogous payment…”

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 13) a monthly pension supplement established in addition to an old-age insurance pension or a disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disabilities, awarded in accordance with Federal Law of 28 December 2013 No. 400-ФЗ ‘On Insurance Pensions’ or awarded early in accordance with Federal Law of 12 December 2023 No. 565-ФЗ ‘On Employment of the Population in the Russian Federation’ (hereinafter referred to as the pension supplement). A pension supplement is established where the civil servant has a length of civil service whose minimum duration for the relevant year is determined in accordance with Appendix 2 to Federal Law of 15 December 2001 No. 166-ФЗ ‘On State Pension Provision in the Russian Federation’, in an amount such that the sum of the old-age insurance pension or the disability insurance pension for a person with a Group I or II disability and the pension supplement equals 55 percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration for the last civil service position held before reaching the age specified in Appendix 5 to the Federal Law ‘On Insurance Pensions’ or before dismissal from the civil service. The pension supplement increases by three percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration for each full year of service beyond the minimum length of civil service established by federal legislation for the relevant year; the sum of the old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for a person with a Group I or II disability and the pension supplement may not exceed 80 percent of the civil servant’s monthly monetary remuneration. The monthly monetary remuneration taken into account in calculating the pension supplement is established by the Mayor of Moscow. The pension supplement is recalculated in cases provided for by a decree of the Mayor of Moscow, including a centrally determined increase in the remuneration salary, old-age insurance pension or disability insurance pension for persons with Group I or II disabilities. Expenses connected with transferring pension supplements to civil servants’ accounts are paid from the budget of the City of Moscow. 14) the guarantees provided for by Article 53.1 of the Federal Law ‘On the State Civil Service of the Russian Federation’ in connection with a civil servant’s call-up for military service under mobilization, assignment to service in the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation under mobilization, conclusion of a military service contract during mobilization, martial law or wartime, or conclusion of a contract for voluntary assistance in performing tasks assigned to the Armed Forces of the Russian Federation or the National Guard troops of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Point 13 Part 1 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 2. Funeral service expenses are reimbursed to the civil servant’s family members or other persons arranging the civil servant’s funeral.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 3. A civil servant who has retired from civil service and is entitled to pension provision under the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families, or, before that law enters into force, to a pension supplement under this Article, retains the state guarantees provided for by points 5-9 of part 1 and part 2 of this Article, including for family members depending on the category and group of the civil service position held.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 4. A civil servant dismissed because of a reduction of civil service positions or the abolition of a state body, who is entitled to a pension supplement, but no earlier than two years before reaching the age specified in Appendix 5 to the Federal Law ‘On Insurance Pensions’, retains the state guarantees provided for by points 8 and 9 of part 1 and part 2 of this Article, including for family members depending on the category and group of the civil service position held, pending the accrual of the old-age insurance pension during the period in which the age conferring entitlement to that pension is reached, but for no more than five months from dismissal from the civil service.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 5. The procedure and conditions for providing a civil servant with the state guarantees under this Article, the family members covered by the corresponding guarantees, and the procedure and conditions for awarding and recalculating pension supplements are determined by decrees of the Mayor of Moscow.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 6. If, after dismissal from the civil service, a citizen fails to observe the prohibitions established by part 3 of Article 13 of this Law, the additional state guarantees provided for civil servants cease and are not restored upon remedying the violation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 7. Expenses connected with the state guarantees provided for by this Article are paid from the budget of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 8. Expenditure on state guarantees expressed in monetary terms is incurred in addition to the approved civil servants’ remuneration fund of the state body and is subject to indexation (increase) at the times and by the amounts by which the prices of the relevant services and tariffs increase.
units.label: Part 8 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 9. This part was repealed with effect from 11 July 2011 by Law of the City of Moscow of 8 June 2011 No. 24.
units.label: Part 9 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 42. Additional state guarantees for civil servants
units.text: 10. This part was repealed with effect from 17 October 2009 by Law of the City of Moscow of 16 September 2009 No. 34.
units.label: Part 10 Art. 42

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.label: Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 1. Length (total duration) of civil service shall include periods of holding:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 1) civil service positions, military positions and positions in other types of federal state service;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 2) state offices;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 3) municipal offices;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 4) municipal service positions;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 5) other positions in accordance with federal laws.
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 2. In addition to periods of holding the positions specified in part 1 of this Article, other periods of holding positions on a list approved by the President of the Russian Federation shall be included (credited) in length of civil service for establishing a civil servant's monthly supplement to the position salary for length of civil service, determining the duration of additional annual paid leave for length of service and the amount of incentives for impeccable and effective civil service, in accordance with the procedure for calculating length of civil service established by the President of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 43

units.locator: Article 43. Length of civil service
units.text: 3. The length of civil service for awarding a length-of-service pension to civil servants is established in accordance with the federal law on state pension provision for citizens of the Russian Federation who have performed state service and their families.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 43

units.text: Chapter 11. Incentives and awards. Service discipline in the civil service

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.label: Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1. The following types of incentives and awards shall apply for impeccable and effective civil service:
units.label: Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 1) a declaration of gratitude with payment of a lump-sum incentive;
units.label: Point 1 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 2) award of a certificate of honour of the state body, with payment of a lump-sum incentive or presentation of a valuable gift;
units.label: Point 2 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 3) other types of incentives and awards of the state body;
units.label: Point 3 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 4) conferral of awards and honorary titles of the City of Moscow;
units.label: Point 4 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 5) incentives from the President of the Russian Federation and federal state bodies;
units.label: Point 5 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 6) award of state honours of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 6 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 7) this point was repealed with effect from 14 December 2020 by Law of the City of Moscow of 25 November 2020 No. 26,;
units.label: Point 7 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 8) this point was repealed with effect from 14 December 2020 by Law of the City of Moscow of 25 November 2020 No. 26, 2. A decision to grant an incentive or award to a civil servant in accordance with points 1-3 of part 1 of this Article is taken by the employer’s representative within the competence established by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Point 8 Part 1 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 3. A decision to grant an incentive or award to a civil servant in accordance with point 4 of part 1 of this Article is taken on the recommendation of the employer’s representative in accordance with the procedure established by laws and other regulatory legal acts of the City of Moscow.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 44

units.locator: Article 44. Incentives and awards for civil service
units.text: 4. A decision to grant an incentive or award to a civil servant in accordance with points 5 and 6 of part 1 of this Article is taken on the recommendation of the employer’s representative in accordance with the procedure established by federal laws and other regulatory legal acts.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 44
